rejects.event: George Orwell published his first novel Burmese Days based on his experiences.
rejects.quote: George Orwell was stationed at Mandalay for a time while working for the Indian Imperial Police in Burma, and his first novel, Burmese Days (1934), was based on his experiences in Burma.
